name: Thomas Cook (India) Ltd
title: Thomas Cook (India) Ltd - 500413 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 group revenue fell 10% to INR 17,707 mn on Middle East war and MICE timing; India ops and Sterling grew, but DEI and Desert Adventures losses and long-haul weakness drove FY26 EBT down 14% to INR 3,268 mn.

triggers.label: Q4 group revenue down 10%
triggers.quote: the group's revenue stood at INR 17,707 million, reflecting a 10% decrease against the same period last year

triggers.label: Sterling occupancy 61% → 64%
triggers.quote: we have started showing improvements in occupancies from 61 to 64

triggers.label: Travel EBIT margin 5% goal held
triggers.quote: the 5% that we have said is our objective to get to is not getting disturbed

guidance.quote: the 5% that we have said is our objective to get to is not getting disturbed
We expect to cross 95 resorts and 4,500 rooms in 2027

guidance.value: 50% to 60% recovery towards end of year
guidance.quote: I think what we forecast going forward would b e approximately a 50% to 60% recovery towards the end of the year
We expect this process to get completed by Q1 of FY '28

red_flags.label: DEI losses despite cost action
red_flags.quote: it is not done and dusted, but also it will not be continuing in the same form

red_flags.label: MICE and government business timing
red_flags.quote: decisions are getting delayed. So, a lot of it is a wait-and-watch approach

evasions.quote: So Purva, I don't think it's a straight answer like that
I'm sure there are lots that's going on
